propositions: A ticket edited mid-review continues consuming LLM passes after the change, only to fail at sign time when generation.sign_manifest detects own_material mismatch; the cancelled runs waste billing and all checkpoint progress.
The cancel mechanism must scope to own_material only (excluding relation_snapshot and ticket_store_revision) to avoid false cancellations on unrelated ticket writes (regression of bug d70a).

The cancel signal must be detected before recovery path reconstructions in produce_plan_review_verdict, since a step failure alone would be converted to findings and flow to signing and sidecar emission.

The probe runs a single-ticket light read under local_read_context to detect own_material changes at the two between-pass seams (after finders and after decide), without fetch/reconverge or sync locks.

A detected own_material change returns an INDETERMINATE verdict with plan-review-cancelled-stale finding, unsigned and not emitted to sidecar, resulting in CLI exit code 2 and skipping all downstream prompt steps.
The cancel path never signs or emits attestations, only withholds them; an undetected change (None fingerprint) fails open and proceeds to sign-time refusal (monotone safety).
